verdict.rationale: Porkbun's own API documentation states it offers CRUD over DNSSEC DS records, so DNSSEC can be managed programmatically. The evidence does not show that Porkbun signs zones itself, offers one-click enablement, or automatically handles DS publication at the registry, so only part of the 'easy' story is documented. Missing for 10: evidence of one-click or automatic zone signing, explicit confirmation that DS records are pushed to the registry, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, DNSSEC is supported and easy — one-click or API-driven signing with the DS records handled at the registry

citations.quote: Full CRUD over records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, CAA, ALIAS, …) and DNSSEC DS records on Porkbun's nameservers
